title: Theme illustrations — Dinosaurios on the Cartel layout
brief: Style samples for the guest invitation of the children's birthday themes: three ways to draw an original, hand-made-looking SVG illustration for «Dinosaurios» on the Cartel layout at 390 px, so the owner can pick a style before 28 themes are drawn. Same content, same layout and the same seven theme colours in all three, so only the illustration technique differs.

artboards.title: Paper cut-out
artboards.tradeoff: Chunky, warm and instantly readable at 390 px, and each theme becomes a physical diorama; the heaviest hand-drawing of the three, and a busy scene needs a tall header

artboards.title: Ink line and wash
artboards.tradeoff: The most obviously hand-made and the most human, with room for personality per theme; the naivest of the three and the most expensive to draw, because every contour is drawn as a line

artboards.title: Risograph, three inks
artboards.tradeoff: The most designed and the cheapest to scale to 28 themes, with a shareable screen system; its three-ink discipline flattens themes that depend on many hues
